title: AI search is fragmenting, ageing and filling with ads

content_html:
A year ago, AI search was basically one product with one name: ChatGPT. A new report says that era is already over.

Similarweb’s 2026 Generative AI Landscape report tracks a market that is booming and splintering at once. Generative AI websites drew 9.5 billion visits a month worldwide between June 2025 and May 2026, up 70% on the year. App downloads reached 4.4 billion, up 58%.

The growth is not the surprise. The fragmentation is.

ChatGPT is still the biggest. Its lead is shrinking.

ChatGPT is still the largest standalone AI website, and it remains enormous. But Similarweb says its share of web visits has fallen steadily as Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and DeepSeek pull in audiences of their own.

The app data shows who is climbing. By US monthly active users, year on year, Meta AI grew 435% and Claude 349%. Grok rose 117%, Perplexity 94% and ChatGPT itself 87%. Gemini added 31%. Two names slid backwards: Microsoft’s 365 Copilot fell 31% and DeepSeek 23%.

Google’s answer: bury AI inside search

Google is not standing still. Its AI Overviews now surface on a growing share of US searches, and visits to its conversational AI Mode keep rising. Similarweb puts Overviews on nearly four in ten US searches, pulling more of the journey into an AI-native experience.

That squeezes the open web. News was the only major web category to shrink over the year, down 5%, even as AI chatbots grew 57%. Yet people are not leaving Google: 95% of ChatGPT users still use it too.

AI search is growing up, and some are opting out

The audience is ageing into the mainstream. In May 2024, under-35s were 61% of gen-AI users. By May 2026 they were 50%, with the growth shifting to the over-45s. Durable adoption, the report argues, looks like your parents signing up.

Not everyone is joining. A young cohort is actively opting out and turning to AI-free tools. On DuckDuckGo’s no-AI search, 18-to-24-year-olds make up 33% of users, against 16% of the web overall.

Now come the ads

The clearest sign of a maturing market is that it is filling with ads. In the US, the share of ChatGPT chats carrying an ad jumped from 14% in May 2026 to 26% a month later. Two-thirds appear only after the second prompt, and 65% of users keep chatting once one shows up.

The click-through rate is a slim 0.50%, and the early advertisers are unglamorous: Resume.io, Monday.com and Framer topped the June list. The direction, though, is set.

What it means for brands

For marketers, the report reads as a warning to move. AI referral traffic is surging, up 312% for marketplaces, 278% for news and 237% for travel year on year. The share of ChatGPT answers citing a web source has risen more than fivefold in a year, to 6.8%.

Being the name an AI recommends matters, too. Users visited an AI-recommended brand two to four times as often as a rival. But optimising for AI search is its own game: most referrals, 58.8%, land on homepages, while the pages ChatGPT cites sit two or three folders deep.

“Discovery is no longer tied to a single destination,” said Similarweb’s Baruch Toledano. One caveat runs through the data: these are Similarweb’s estimates from web and app traffic, and they exclude API use and AI folded into other apps. The trend is hard to miss anyway.

content_html_zh:
一年前，人工智能搜索基本上是一个只有一个名称的产品：ChatGPT。 一份新报告称，那个时代已经结束。

Sameweb 的 2026 年生成式 AI 格局报告追踪了一个既繁荣又分裂的市场。 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 5 月期间，生成式 AI 网站每月在全球吸引了 95 亿次访问量，同比增长 70%。 应用程序下载量达到 44 亿次，增长 58%。

增长并不令人意外。 碎片化是。

ChatGPT 仍然是最大的。 它的领先优势正在缩小。

ChatGPT 仍然是最大的独立人工智能网站，而且规模仍然巨大。 但Similarweb表示，随着Gemini、Claude、Perplexity和DeepSeek吸引了自己的受众，其网络访问量份额稳步下降。

应用程序数据显示谁在攀登。 按美国月度活跃用户计算，Meta AI 同比增长 435%，Claude 增长 349%。 Grok 上涨了 117%，Perplexity 上涨了 94%，ChatGPT 本身上涨了 87%。 双子座增加了31%。 有两个名字出现了下滑：微软的 365 Copilot 下跌了 31%，DeepSeek 下跌了 23%。

谷歌的答案：将人工智能埋藏在搜索中

谷歌并没有停滞不前。 目前，其人工智能概述在美国搜索中所占的份额越来越大，其对话式人工智能模式的访问量也在不断增加。 Sameweb 在美国近十分之四的搜索中提供了概述，将更多的旅程带入人工智能原生体验中。

这挤压了开放网络。 新闻是今年唯一一个萎缩的主要网络类别，下降了 5%，尽管人工智能聊天机器人增长了 57%。 然而人们并没有离开 Google：95% 的 ChatGPT 用户仍然在使用它。

人工智能搜索正在发展，但有些人选择退出

观众逐渐老龄化并成为主流。 2024 年 5 月，35 岁以下的人占 gen-AI 用户的 61%。 到 2026 年 5 月，这一比例已达到 50%，且增长转向 45 岁以上人群。 报告认为，持久收养看起来就像你的父母签字同意一样。

并非所有人都加入。 一个年轻群体正在积极选择退出并转向不依赖人工智能的工具。 在 DuckDuckGo 的非人工智能搜索中，18 至 24 岁的用户占 33%，而整个网络的用户比例为 16%。

现在广告来了

市场成熟的最明显标志是它充满了广告。 在美国，带有广告的 ChatGPT 聊天的比例从 2026 年 5 月的 14% 跃升至一个月后的 26%。 三分之二的用户仅在第二次提示后出现，65% 的用户在出现提示后继续聊天。

点击率只有 0.50%，早期的广告商也乏善可陈：Resume.io、Monday.com 和 Framer 在 6 月份的排行榜上名列前茅。 但方向已经确定。

对品牌意味着什么

对于营销人员来说，该报告被视为行动的警告。 AI 推荐流量正在激增，市场同比增长 312%，新闻同比增长 278%，旅游同比增长 237%。 ChatGPT 答案中引用网络资源的比例在一年内增长了五倍多，达到 6.8%。

作为人工智能推荐的名字也很重要。 用户访问人工智能推荐品牌的频率是竞争对手的两到四倍。 但优化人工智能搜索是它自己的游戏：大多数推荐（58.8%）都出现在主页上，而 ChatGPT 引用的页面则位于两三个文件夹深处。

“发现不再局限于单一目的地，”Similarweb 的 Baruch Toledano 说道。 数据中存在一个警告：这些是 Sametime 对网络和应用程序流量的估计，并且不包括 API 使用和融入其他应用程序的人工智能。 无论如何，这一趋势很难被错过。
